blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY—Police seized more than P17.6 million worth of illegal drugs and arrested 20 suspected drug personalities in a series of operations across the Cordillera from November 16 to 22. In a report, the Police Regional Office-Cordillera (PRO-CAR) said it conducted 23 operations during the period, including 11 buy-bust operations and nine marijuana eradication activities. The other operations involved the implementation of a search warrant, service of an arrest warrant and a police response.
